name: Wattaildragon
extDescription:
Capable of indefinite flight. Attacks by wrapping its body with electricity and ramming into opponents.
IMPORTANT: Capturing the "Wattaildragon" is forbidden by the Ancient Rules and is a Level 6 offense, the minimum sentence for which is imprisonment for no less than 2500 heliocycles.

name: Luster Dragon
extDescription: A very beautiful dragon covered with sapphire. It does not like fights, but has incredibly high attack power.

name: Hunter Dragon
extDescription: This dragon has taken down countless prey with its sharp fangs. It strikes very quickly, because if it does not strike first, it is vulnerable to a counter-attack.

name: Millennium Shield
extDescription: A famous shield said to belong to an ancient Egyptian Pharaoh. Legends tell of its power to block any strong attack.

name: Dark Blade
extDescription: They say he is a dragon-manipulating warrior from the dark world. His attack is tremendous, using his great swords with vicious power.

name: Warrior Dai Grepher
extDescription: The warrior who can manipulate dragons. Nobody knows his mysterious past.

name: Chamberlain of the Six Samurai
extDescription: The Six Samurai are supported from the shadows by this silent and mysterious warrior. His past is unknown to them, but his countless scars are proof of his experience.

name: Mystical Elf
extDescription: A delicate elf that lacks offense, but has a terrific defense backed by mystical power.

name: Aether, the Empowering Dragon
extDescription: When this card is Pendulum Summoned: You can target 1 card on the field; return it to the hand. You can only use this effect of "Aether, the Empowering Dragon" once per turn.

name: Ventdra, the Empowered Warrior
extDescription: This card can attack your opponent directly. If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can target 1 Dragon, Warrior, or Spellcaster-Type Normal Monster in your Graveyard; add it to your hand.

name: Arnis, the Empowered Warrior
extDescription: When this card you control is destroyed by battle with an opponent's attacking monster and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Spellcaster-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck in Attack Position.

name: Terratiger, the Empowered Warrior
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from your hand in Defense Position.

name: Hydrotortoise, the Empowered Warrior
extDescription: FLIP: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy it.

name: Golden Dragon Summoner
extDescription: You can Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 monster on the field; return it to the hand. You can only use this effect of "Golden Dragon Summoner" once per turn.

name: Blue Dragon Summoner
extDescription: If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can add 1 Dragon, Warrior, or Spellcaster-Type Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Red Sparrow Summoner
extDescription: When this card you control is destroyed by battle with an opponent's attacking monster and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Warrior-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck in Attack Position.

name: White Tiger Summoner
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from your hand. All monsters you control gain 100 ATK and DEF.

name: Green Turtle Summoner
extDescription: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it.

name: Sorcerous Spell Wall
extDescription: All monsters you control gain 300 ATK during your turn only. All monsters you control gain 300 DEF during your opponent's turn only.

name: Supply Squad
extDescription: Once per turn, if a monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or by card effect: Draw 1 card.

name: Lightning Vortex
extDescription: Discard 1 card; destroy all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

name: Mystical Space Typhoon
extDescription: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Lucky Iron Axe
extDescription: The equipped monster gains 500 ATK. If this face-up card you control is destroyed by your opponent's card effect and sent to your Graveyard: Draw 1 card.

name: Axe of Despair
extDescription:
(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)
The equipped monster gains 1000 ATK. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can Tribute 1 monster; place this card on the top of your Deck.

name: Monster Reincarnation
extDescription: Discard 1 card. Add 1 Monster Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

name: Dark Factory of Mass Production
extDescription: Target 2 Normal Monsters in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand.

name: Poison of the Old Man
extDescription:
Activate 1 of these effects;
? Gain 1200 LP.
? Inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

name: Trap Hole
extDescription: When your opponent Normal or Flip Summons 1 monster with 1000 or more ATK: Target that monster; destroy that target.

name: Sakuretsu Armor
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; destroy that target.

name: Raigeki Break
extDescription: Discard 1 card, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it.

name: Dust Tornado
extDescription: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target, then you can Set 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand.

name: Shadow Spell
extDescription: Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; it loses 700 ATK, also it cannot attack or change its battle position. When it leaves the field, destroy this card.

name: A Hero Emerges
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Your opponent chooses 1 random card from your hand, then if it is a monster that can be Special Summoned, Special Summon it. Otherwise, send it to the Graveyard.

name: Soul Resurrection
extDescription: Activate this card by targeting 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in Defense Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Jar of Greed
extDescription: Draw 1 card.

name: Magic Jammer
extDescription: When a Spell Card is activated: Discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Seven Tools of the Bandit
extDescription: When a Trap Card is activated: Pay 1000 LP; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Timegazer Magician
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect You must control no monsters to activate this card. If a Pendulum Monster you control attacks or is attacked, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. Unless you have a "Magician" card or "Odd-Eyes" card in your other Pendulum Zone, this card's Pendulum Scale becomes 4..
Monster Effect Each turn, the first card(s) in your Pendulum Zone that would be destroyed by an opponent's card effect, is not destroyed.

name: Stargazer Magician
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect If a Pendulum Monster you control attacks or is attacked, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards until the end of the Damage Step. Unless you have a "Magician" card or "Odd-Eyes" card in your other Pendulum Zone, this card's Pendulum Scale becomes 4.
Monster Effect Once per turn, when exactly 1 other Pendulum Monster you control (and no other cards) is returned to your hand by an opponent's card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand with the same name as that returned to the hand.

name: Ego Boost
extDescription: When a monster declares an attack: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 1000 ATK until the end of the Battle Phase.
